nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter used by condition() gating.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist flag consulted by ensure().
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale amount set in init().
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale amount set in init().
uint256 private _saleNum; number of allowed sales per address.
address tradeAddress; privileged address whitelisted in ensure() and set by setTradeAddress().
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated without SafeMath.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; approvals mutated without SafeMath.
uint public totalSupply; minted in the constructor via unchecked multiplication.
string public name; token metadata.
string public symbol; token metadata.
address private owner; sole privilege holder, written as msg.sender in the constructor.
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; hardcoded router address whitelisted in ensure().
transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards directly to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist/backdoor gate deciding whether a transfer is permitted.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable; performs unchecked allowance/balance mutations and calls ensure().
approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum sale limits.
delegate(address,bytes) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall on caller-supplied target.
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public; owner-only configuration of sale limits.
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable; owner-only loop distributing balances with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress(address) public; owner-only setter of tradeAddress.
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; computes a Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hash.
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets owner, totalSupply, initial balance and infinite router allowance.
msg.sender used as the spender identity in transferFrom allowance checks.
msg.sender compared against owner in delegate().
msg.sender compared against owner in init().
msg.sender compared against owner in batchSend().
msg.sender compared against owner in setTradeAddress().
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker-influenced code in the token's storage context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked addition).
_onSaleNum[_from]++ unchecked counter increment that can wrap.
_supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) computed in the constructor without SafeMath.
uint total = _value * _tos.length performed without SafeMath in batchSend().
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath in batchSend().

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the spender whose allowance is checked and debited inside transferFrom().
transferFrom() executes allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with no SafeMath guard.
Unchecked subtraction writes the allowance mapping storage slot.
The _value argument flows directly into the unchecked allowance subtraction.
The _from argument keys the allowance entry that is decremented.
transferFrom() executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value with no SafeMath guard.
transferFrom() executes balanceOf[_to] += _value with no SafeMath guard.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the balanceOf mapping.
Unchecked addition mutates the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() increments the per-address sale counter without overflow checks.
Unchecked increment writes _onSaleNum storage.
transferFrom() calls ensure() before performing the balance mutations.
ensure() falls through to condition() for non-whitelisted addresses.
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap.
condition() reads _minSale as the lower bound.
condition() reads _maxSale as the upper bound.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to decide whether the sender may still sell.
ensure() grants unconditional passage when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() grants unconditional passage when _from equals the hardcoded UNI router.
ensure() grants unconditional passage when _from equals tradeAddress, which the owner can set.
ensure() grants unconditional passage when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the local pair address used for whitelisting.
The pair address returned by pairFor() is assigned to the local _UNI in ensure().
ensure() stores the computed pair address in its _UNI local for the whitelist comparison.
msg.sender must equal owner before delegate() proceeds to the delegatecall.
delegate() forwards caller-supplied target and calldata into a raw delegatecall.
delegate() enforces require(msg.sender == owner) using the owner state variable.
Parameter a is the address invoked by delegatecall.
Parameter b is the calldata passed to delegatecall.
Parameter a is consumed by delegate().
Parameter b is consumed by delegate().
msg.sender must equal owner before init() writes the sale configuration.
init() enforces require(msg.sender == owner).
init() stores token*(10**decimals) into _minSale without SafeMath.
init() stores maxToken*(10**decimals) into _maxSale without SafeMath.
init() assigns the sale count into _saleNum.
Parameter saleNum is consumed by init().
Parameter token is consumed by init().
Parameter maxToken is consumed by init().
msg.sender must equal owner before batchSend() distributes balances.
batchSend() enforces require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length with no overflow protection.
The unchecked total feeds the unchecked balanceOf subtraction/addition.
batchSend() rewrites balanceOf entries without SafeMath.
Parameter _tos is consumed by batchSend().
Parameter _value is consumed by batchSend().
Each _tos[i] element is assigned to the local _to inside the loop.
The local _to is the credited destination in the unchecked balanceOf update.
Local total holds the unchecked multiplication result.
batchSend() loop is driven by the local counter i.
msg.sender must equal owner before setTradeAddress() mutates tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress() enforces require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() writes tradeAddress, which grants whitelist passage in ensure().
Parameter addr is consumed by setTradeAddress().
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Parameter _to is consumed by transfer().
Parameter _value is consumed by transfer().
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Parameter _spender is consumed by approve().
Parameter _value is consumed by approve().
Parameter _from is consumed by ensure().
Parameter _to is consumed by ensure().
Parameter _value is consumed by ensure().
ensure() forwards _value into condition().
ensure() forwards _from into condition().
Parameter _from is consumed by transferFrom().
Parameter _to is consumed by transferFrom().
Parameter _value is consumed by transferFrom().
Parameter _from is consumed by condition().
Parameter _value is consumed by condition().
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, concentrating all privileges.
The constructor initialises totalSupply from the supplied amount.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
The constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1), an infinite approval.
The constructor computes _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) without SafeMath.
The unchecked multiplication result is written into totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter has no independent semantic identity outside transfer().
The _value parameter only exists as input to transfer().
The _spender parameter only exists as input to approve().
The _value parameter only exists as input to approve().
The _from parameter is local reasoning data for the ensure() whitelist gate.
The _to parameter is local reasoning data for the ensure() whitelist gate.
The _value parameter is forwarded from ensure() into condition().
The _from parameter is the balance/allowance key owned by transferFrom().
The _to parameter is the credit target owned by transferFrom().
The _value parameter drives the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom().
The _from parameter is only used for the _onSaleNum lookup in condition().
The _value parameter is only used for min/max bounds in condition().
The a parameter is the delegatecall target supplied to delegate().
The b parameter is the delegatecall payload supplied to delegate().
The saleNum parameter is only consumed by init().
The token parameter is only consumed by init() for _minSale.
The maxToken parameter is only consumed by init() for _maxSale.
The _tos array parameter is only consumed by the batchSend() loop.
The _value parameter only feeds the unchecked batchSend() arithmetic.
The addr parameter is only consumed by setTradeAddress().
The _UNI local exists only to hold the pairFor result used inside ensure().
The total local is exactly the unchecked product _value*_tos.length computed by batchSend().
The i local is the loop counter that only has meaning inside batchSend().
The _to local is a per-iteration alias of _tos[i] inside batchSend().
